notes: Anchor check passed: average GMAT Focus 689 and average Classic 738 confirmed for Class of 2027. FT 2026 rank is null because Stanford was absent from the FT ranking for a second consecutive year (insufficient alumni survey responses, per Poets&Quants FT 2026 coverage). Class profile data as of 17 September 2025 per the page. Stanford does not publish an acceptance rate; the profile lists 7,259 total applicants and 434 new students but no admit count. Profile and employment statistics render via Infogram embeds on the official gsb.stanford.edu pages; values were read from those embeds. Both GMAT editions are reported separately by Stanford (no conversion performed). Tuition updated from the prior 2025-26 figure (85,755) to the published 2026-27 first-year rate.
